name: EPAX 3D
summary: US-based maker of LCD/resin 3D printers (active since 2014, shipping from a North Carolina office) that also sells a side line of 1.75 mm, 1 kg FDM filament: high-speed PLA variants, silk and glow PLA, PETG, ASA, TPU 95A and PETG-CF. The filament's actual extruder is not disclosed.

product_lines.name: Fast PLA+ / High Speed PLA
product_lines.notes: Marketed as high-speed PLA+; 'compatible with Bambu AMS' is a compatibility claim only.

product_lines.name: PETG-CF
product_lines.notes: Listed on the shop but not in the SpoolmanDB PR (#357).

additional_notes: Printer maker first; filament is an accessory line. EPAX Dental is a separate site. Legal entity and city not established (trades as 'EPAX 3D'). No filament OEM identified, so oem_relationships is empty. Price tier not checked.

provenance.conflicts: Identity is medium confidence; manufacturing origin and filament OEM are unknown (low). 'North Carolina Office' is a shipping origin, not a confirmed HQ.
